That token now reaches `Sheet.fetchGridByReferences` and the cross-sheet resolution helpers (`parseCrossSheetRef`, `getWorksheetCell` — imported in packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts), none of which are in this diff.
